notes.title: Tiles II - Multiplayer - Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Added:

-Added setting to enable/disable player level display
-Added Crashlytics to determine future problems.
-Added gender choice in Tiles II registration so it finally respects you.

Fixed:

- Fixed a bug related to the missing “Pet” power skin.
- Fixed a bug in hotfix where Za Hando's 3D model would not load.
- Fixed a bug related to the impossibility of clicking on a button in the player's settings in an attempt to set “Escape” as the game key is performed.
- Fixed a bug related to game integrity.

Not fixed but to be expected:

- In a future update, we will try to fix the problem of the player's connection to the game for all operating systems.

notes.title: Tiles II - Multiplayer - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
This update brings a few additions and corrections: 

- New power in contamination mode: Contamination Bomb
This power can infect players within a 5-tile radius.
- Team mutator tutorial added.
- The mutators (map size, game time) for elimination, contamination and power modes have been revised.
- The probabilities of game-impeding powers have been greatly reduced in favor of filler powers.
- The player is immune to death for 3 seconds after reappearing (except helicopter ammunition).
- Player display corrected
- Correction related to unauthenticated player login

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Tiles II Multiplayer 0.5.1 Update
notes.content:
[b]-[/b] Set your game to know precisely which tiles you have, this allows you to know if other players have the same skin as you to know who to take territory from.
[b]-[/b] You have a 1 in 15 chance of getting the 
apache prime when you have the helicopter, it launches missiles that target the opponents!
[b]-[/b] Fixed:
[list]
[*] Display of the map creator
[*] Speed less dependent on framerate (still under development)
[*] Display of host ping in main menu
[*] Help with powers
[/list]
